A '''planet''' was in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Its inhabitants were at war for centuries with the [[Niordi]] from the [[Niorde system/Legends|Niorde system]], and eventually defeated the Niordi with help from hired [[Mercenary/Legends|merceneries]] from the [[Leech Legion]]s.
